answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. By the pulse of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, reset on any identity-link attempt, no identity may audit its own recruit. The tundra is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the dune. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short.
